name: General Mills - Chattanooga TN Distribution Center

fieldNotes.siteIdentity: Confirmed General Mills Chattanooga distribution center, 650 Wauhatchie Pike, Chattanooga TN 37419 (verified via Yelp, Manta, Hyster GM plant locations list). Large two-building DC complex on the west bank of the rail corridor; the roster address (650) is the southern of the two long warehouse buildings. A second General Mills address (960 Wauhatchie Pike) is the northern building - both are part of the same fenced industrial complex.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence. The main truck entrance is a wide paved driveway off Wauhatchie Pike in the gap between the two buildings; Street View (2025-10) shows a fence-line gate opening signed 'Gate 3' with a sliding gate panel and yellow concrete jersey barriers channelizing the lane. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the Gate 3 entrance in any Street View heading - just the gate opening and barriers. guardShack = false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present with no guard booth, implying kiosk / call-box / app or remote check-in. remoteGs = true (medium confidence - listed uncertain).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Each of the two long buildings has an extensive dock-door bank running its full length with dozens of trailers backed in; the southern (650) building alone shows roughly 50-60 dock positions. dockDoors band 50+. Count is an estimate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer yards along the dock faces and in the open paved lots, with well over 100 trailers parked across the complex - many without tractors. dropArea band 50+, dedicated drop yard present.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: The southern building has a long dock bank on its SW face (fronting Wauhatchie Pike) and a separate rail-served dock on its NE/E face alongside the rail spurs - physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail spurs run into the property along the east side with covered hopper cars and boxcars parked at the rail dock - the complex is rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two large warehouse buildings (650 and 960 Wauhatchie Pike) on the same fenced complex - a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial corridor along Wauhatchie Pike at the foot of Lookout Mountain, west of Chattanooga proper, with woods/ridge and scattered rural residential nearby - judged Rural per the rubric's small-town-vs-urban tie-breaker.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The Gate 3 driveway runs a long way from Wauhatchie Pike into the interior yard between the buildings before reaching the docks - deep approach, holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Wauhatchie Pike is a low-traffic two-lane road and the gate apron has ample paved width, so a truck queue at the gate would not block a public artery.
